soldier-initiative-and-upgrade-stock.head: 37bd84be5ac5132659d0356360a5df32e8606bd9
soldier-initiative-and-upgrade-stock.scope: Native PacketLog 820770acccfd lines 146, 817 and 1097 show the +2 Initiative Bonus add, remove and add. Lines 820 and 1100 remove and restore the 1061 grant. The +84 Desperation snapshot persists through the Soldier unload and expires naturally.

desperation-health-snapshot-stock.head: 37bd84be5ac5132659d0356360a5df32e8606bd9
desperation-health-snapshot-stock.scope: Using the pre-placed shortcut at 100/500 HP applies +84 for 20 seconds with 90 seconds of reuse. The stock run kept that snapshot through the Soldier unload and observed its natural expiry. This covers the ability effect and leaves retail interlock application open.

stats.source: GOB Gunman adds +1 Initiative Bonus 1046 while loaded. DesperationFunction in tempmods.py reads stat 1046 as a percentage at application.
stats.runtime: AbilityPassives supplies the Gunman bonus to AbilityStats.Player. AbilityScaledBuffs reads that total when it creates the Desperation health snapshot.
stats.test: LoadedGunmanAndGunslingerRetainTheShippedInitiativeBonusAndGrant and StarterInitiativeBatchMode independently check the +1 record and unload/reload. PR453 native PacketLog 820770acccfd line 146 contains Gunman +1, Soldier +2 and prerequisite +2. The stock cast then snapshots +84 rather than the unmodified +80. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/453

stats.source: GOB Soldier adds +2 Initiative Bonus 1046 and grants Soldier Upgrade 1061. DesperationFunction in tempmods.py uses 1046 at application.
stats.runtime: AbilityPassives supplies the Soldier modifier and AbilityProgression manages child membership. AbilityScaledBuffs reads the initiative bonus when taking the snapshot.

consumer.source: The shipped DesperationFunction reads Initiative Bonus 1046 as a percentage when setting Initiative 1044.
consumer.runtime: The Soldier passive contributes +2 to the current 1046 total at snapshot. Unloading Soldier clears that contribution for future casts while preserving the established snapshot.
consumer.test: StarterInitiativeBatchMode applies the stock frame with the Soldier bonus loaded, then unloads Soldier and observes the unchanged +84 until expiry. PR453 confirms the same outcome natively. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/453

behavior-tests.source: GOB 154 lists Initiative Bonus +2 while enabled and the Soldier Upgrade 1061 grant.
behavior-tests.runtime: The loaded Soldier row publishes the modifier and grant, consumes its bonus through Desperation, and removes modifier and grant on unload.
behavior-tests.test: StarterInitiativeBatchMode verifies both loadout records in each direction, then the live cast and its snapshot through source unload. Stock PR453 independently captured grant 1061 on/off and the +2 lifecycle. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/453

behavior-tests.source: GOB 1149 stores 10 IS, 90-second reuse, 10 buffer cost and a 20-second health-based Initiative modifier. DesperationFunction snapshots health and Initiative Bonus at application.
behavior-tests.runtime: AbilityDesperation resolves the one-time bonus. AbilityBuffs owns lifecycle and buffer accounting. AbilityCooldowns and AbilityCosts own reuse and cost.
behavior-tests.test: AbilityDesperationTests covers health boundaries, bonus cap, snapshot, cost, buffer, unload, natural expiry and cleanup. InterlockInitiativeTests covers the current interlock consumer. StarterInitiativeBatchMode and stock PR453 verify casting, 90-second reuse and a +84 snapshot until natural expiry. Retail interlock policy remains a source check. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/453
